title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Voice Retention / Representation Ratio metric to compare the survival rate of low-frequency (singleton) employee concerns versus high-frequency concerns in LLM-generated summaries.
Auditing the retention rate of non-majority-language (German) employee comments compared to the overall English-dominant corpus rate during LLM summarization.
Comparing the survival rate of themes raised in short, terse comments (at or below median character length) versus elaborated comments during summarization.
Using a cluster-robust logit model to evaluate the retention of critical/prohibitive voice versus positive/promotive voice to test for valence-based filtering.
